title: Dance Studio Software Comparison (2026): Prices Side by Side
description: Jackrabbit, Studio Pro (DanceStudio-Pro), Akada, The Studio Director and Studio Helper compared: published prices, trials, recital tools and payment fees.
body:
Our dance and yoga studio software page covers general booking platforms like Mindbody, Zen Planner and Gymdesk. This page compares five tools that market themselves directly to dance studios, with recital, costume and tuition features those general tools don't focus on. All prices are from each vendor's own pricing page, checked November 8, 2026. Where a vendor doesn't publish something, we say unknown.

{{table:jackrabbit-class,studio-pro,akada,studio-director,studio-helper}}

Monthly cost at a glance

ToolPricing model~80 students~200 students

Subscription only. Payment processing, texting overages and setup fees are extra where they apply (see below). Studio Helper figures are our arithmetic from its published $50/mo + $0.25 per student.

Jackrabbit Class (Jackrabbit Dance)

Jackrabbit's core plan starts at $49/mo and is priced by total student count at the end of each month; the pricing page doesn't publish the tiers above that. It lists no contracts or setup fees, free data imports and unlimited support. A custom-branded parent app (Jackrabbit Plus) starts at $93/mo plus a one-time, non-refundable $169 setup fee and app store fees. Enterprise is $245/mo flat ($331/mo with the app). Its dance pages list automated tuition billing, recital planning, costume sizing and ordering, and waivers by recreational or competitive level. No free trial is published; you request a demo. Jackrabbit overview. {{aff:jackrabbitclass|Visit Jackrabbit}}

Studio Pro (formerly DanceStudio-Pro)

DanceStudio-Pro now redirects to Studio Pro. Every plan includes unlimited students: Essentials $49/mo, Premier $79/mo and Elite $165/mo. Even Essentials includes class registration, tuition, payments, point of sale, a parent portal app, recital planning, costume management and ticket sales. Premier adds in-app two-way chat, user permissions and Zapier; Elite adds lead capture, trial-to-enrollment automation, two-way texting (U.S. and Canada) with 3,000 texts a month ($0.02 per extra text) and a dedicated studio number. Its built-in Stripe processing starts at 2.66% + $0.25 for U.S. merchants; using another processor adds a 1.35% Studio Pro tech fee. The 30-day free trial needs no credit card, but lead management and payment processing are off during the trial. Studio Pro overview. {{aff:studiopro|Visit Studio Pro}}

Akada Software

Akada charges one flat $60/mo with every feature and no tiers. It lists online registration with approvals, class scheduling with conflict checks, tuition billing, recurring card payments through Stripe, staff time tracking, recital scheduling with costume sizing and billing, 200+ reports, free texting and two-way messaging, plus a family app (Akada Portal) and an instructor app for attendance (Akada Studio). Trial, contract terms and processing rates are not published. Akada overview. {{aff:akada|Visit Akada}}

The Studio Director

The Studio Director publishes its whole price table. For 0-100 students it's $65/mo software only or $39/mo if you also process payments through it; 101-250 students is $119 or $79; 251-500 is $169 or $119; 501-1000 is $199 or $149; larger studios run up to $329/mo. It's month-to-month with no setup fee and a 30-day money-back guarantee instead of a free trial. Features it lists include a parent portal for enrollment and trial or makeup requests, recitals with ticket sales, costume sizing charts for major vendors, drip email and texting, and attendance reports. Processing rates aren't published. Studio Director overview. {{aff:studiodirector|Visit The Studio Director}}

Studio Helper

Studio Helper is one plan at $50/mo plus $0.25 per student, with a 30-day free trial. It covers several kinds of teaching studios (music, dance, yoga, martial arts) and adds payroll, expense and inventory tracking, but we found no recital or costume tools listed. Studio Helper overview. {{aff:studio-helper|Visit Studio Helper}}

How to choose

  • Small studio, lowest subscription: The Studio Director at $39/mo for up to 100 students, if you'll use its payment processing. Otherwise Studio Pro Essentials at $49/mo or Akada at $60/mo.
  • Growing past a few hundred students: the flat-priced tools (Studio Pro and Akada) don't go up with enrollment. The Studio Director and Jackrabbit do.
  • Two-way texting with parents: Akada includes free texting and two-way messaging. Studio Pro has two-way in-app chat from Premier ($79/mo) and two-way SMS only on Elite ($165/mo).
  • A branded app with your studio's name: Jackrabbit Plus (from $93/mo + $169 setup). The others offer their own-branded parent apps or portals.
  • Recitals and costumes: Jackrabbit, Studio Pro, Akada and The Studio Director all list recital and costume tools.

Before switching, compare processing fees too: see billing software and processing fees (written for martial arts schools, but the fee math is the same) and our software buying checklist. UK studios may also want to look at Dance Business Solutions, a done-for-you marketing and operations suite. More tools: all dance studio software · Mindbody alternatives.
faq: What is the cheapest dance studio software?

Of the dance-specific tools we checked on November 8, 2026, The Studio Director is $39/mo for up to 100 students if you use its payment processing ($65/mo without). Jackrabbit Class and Studio Pro Essentials both start at $49/mo, and Akada is a flat $60/mo with every feature.
Which dance studio software has unlimited students?

Studio Pro says all its packages (Essentials $49/mo, Premier $79/mo, Elite $165/mo) include unlimited students. Akada charges one flat $60/mo with no tiers. Jackrabbit Class and The Studio Director are priced by student count.
Is DanceStudio-Pro the same as Studio Pro?
Yes. dancestudio-pro.com now redirects to gostudiopro.com/dance, and Studio Pro's pricing and payment pages still refer to DanceStudio-Pro.

Only the starting points: Jackrabbit Class from $49/mo, Jackrabbit Plus from $93/mo plus a $169 one-time setup fee, and Enterprise at $245/mo ($331/mo with the branded app). The student-count tiers above the starting price aren't published on its pricing page.
Which dance studio software has a free trial?

Studio Pro offers 30 days with no credit card (lead management and payment processing aren't available during the trial). Studio Helper offers a 30-day free trial. The Studio Director offers a 30-day money-back guarantee instead. We found no published free trial for Jackrabbit or Akada.
